verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents persistent storage, shared drives across machines, and CLI/API/SDK access for programmatic resource management (paperspace-docs-4, paperspace-docs-6, paperspace-docs-23, paperspace-docs-24, paperspace-docs-30), which provide some transfer/automation tooling, but there is no mention of an S3-compatible endpoint or dedicated cloud-storage sync feature. A hands-on community report explicitly complains that copying datasets into Paperspace VMs is slow and SSH access is cumbersome (paperspace-comm-7), undercutting the 'efficient' data movement claim. missing for 10: S3-compatible storage endpoint, explicit cloud-storage sync integration, independent verification of transfer speed/efficiency.
